title: MEIKO — Third Senpai〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: Don't Let Doubts Hold You Back

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you so much for lending me your ear, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: No, it was my pleasure! I'll see you later, okay?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What were you and Honami talking about, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, just some stuff about drumming!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Speaking of drumming, I can still keep going.
How about a session with just us three?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Sure, of course.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Wow! That was fun!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's so nice to know I can go all out when we're playing together like this.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
You handle my improvisations so well too.
It feels great to play each note!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I can sort of just sense it.
How others want to play.
What others are trying to do and such.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Right. And you can't help but throw yourself into a song after you start hearing those around you play!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Words can't describe how good it feels!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, but you know what? Not everything has to be perfect.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Are you thinking about Ichika and the others?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They only just formed their band, so it feels like they're still not quite sure what they want to do.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm pretty sure they'll really start to improve once they find their groove but...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Did you notice how they'd sometimes randomly go off tune when they're not being careful?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Well, that may be true...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haha! Sorry, sorry! I'm not trying to put down your precious girls, I promise.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Seriously, I didn't mean it in a bad way.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: This is a period of mutual discovery and learning about one another. It's an important part of being a new band and gaining experience.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: True.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I agree. The girls are definitely trying to listen to each other carefully and figure out what they want to do.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Exactly! Sometimes, everything just falls into place and they have an amazing session all of the sudden!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's always exciting to see how things will unfold with them!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I agree. I definitely feel that way when I play with them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: See? And they have so much fun playing together too.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's why every melody they create sounds so bright and cheerful, at least for me!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I really love them. How do they produce such a unique sound? It's almost as if it sparkles or twinkles.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Well, that's an easy one.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Their band is what brought them all back together.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right. And coming together like this helped them find their true feelings as well, while we hope all four of them will keep the band going for as long as possible.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: All four of them, huh...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You know, I see you two playing together with them fairly often, but you rarely give them any advice about being a band or anything.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You're right.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The band was our suggestion, but they eventually found their true feelings on their own.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So it seems best to just watch over them.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. You'd be surprised by how mature and thoughtful they can be sometimes.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see. So you're not interfering too much because you trust that they'll figure this out on their own?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haha! You really believe in them, don't you?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Of course! We're talking about the girls, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Okay, I can do that too!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I only just met them, but I'm already looking forward to what they have in store for us!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Join the club.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Gladly!
